basic_details.job_title: NHSRC Media Executive Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC), New Delhi, acting on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, is inviting online applications for one Media Executive post in the SNA Section, MoHFW, purely on contractual basis. The pay range is Rs. 36,000/- – 41,000/- PM. The essential requirement is a graduation degree with minimum 2 years of experience in the relevant field, and the age must be less than 41 years as on 1 January 2026. Applications are made on the NHSRC website (http://nhsrcindia.org) and the last date is 20 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Candidates should be less than 41 years as on 1 January 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

qualification.details: Additional qualification in the field of Mass Communication/Journalism will be an added advantage. Work experience of Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies is desirable.

how_to_apply: Open the online application available on the NHSRC website (http://nhsrcindia.org).
Fill in the online application correctly.
Submit it in the prescribed online application format, which is the only format accepted.
Make sure the application is received by 20 November 2026.
The notice names no documents to be attached and gives no other application steps.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Media Executive at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC), New Delhi, on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: The National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi. In this notice it is seeking applications on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare for the Media Executive post in the Ministry's SNA Section. The notice calls the document "Terms of Reference" and is printed in English and Hindi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Additional qualification in the field of Mass Communication/Journalism will be an added advantage. Work experience of Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies is desirable. Candidates should be less than 41 years as on 1 January 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: Graduation Degree with minimum 2 years of experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration range is Rs. 36,000/- – 41,000/- PM. The engagement is purely on contractual basis. The notice states that consultants are entitled to an annual increment at 5% per annum on renewal of their contract. This may be given for the five years of engagement of consultants in a particular level. The Media Executive reports to the Addl. DG (Media)/Chief of Media & Communications, MoHFW/Media & Communications Officer, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Media Executive Job Description
content_sections.text: The Media Executive will be responsible for overseeing media, communication, and creative activities of assigned divisions in the Ministry. The Media Executive will collaborate closely with the officials of the division and the media team to ensure that information is disseminated accurately, promptly, and professionally.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Media Executive
content_sections.text: Open the online application available on the NHSRC website ( http://nhsrcindia.org ). Fill in the online application correctly. Submit it in the prescribed online application format, which is the only format accepted. Make sure the application is received by 20 November 2026. The notice names no documents to be attached and gives no other application steps.
